topics.answer: Harbor & Hearth Kitchen is a synthetic full-service modern American neighborhood restaurant with Pacific Northwest influence. Dinner averages $25-$45 per person before alcohol.
Call (503) 555-0148, email hello@harborandhearth.example, or visit https://harborandhearth.example. These are synthetic fixture contacts.
Complimentary still and sparkling water is served at the table. A request for chilled water or water waiting on arrival can be recorded as a guest note.
Harbor & Hearth Kitchen is at 1842 Market Street, Portland, Oregon 97205, two blocks west of Director Park. The main entrance faces Market Street between Southwest 18th and 19th Avenues.

Closed Monday. Tuesday-Thursday 11:30 AM-10 PM; Friday 11:30 AM-11 PM; Saturday 9 AM-11 PM; Sunday 9 AM-9 PM. Brunch is Saturday-Sunday 9 AM-2:30 PM; lunch Tuesday-Friday 11:30 AM-3 PM; dinner starts at 5 PM. Kitchen last call is 30-60 minutes before close as listed in the hours record. Date-specific exceptions override these hours.
Street parking is metered. The synthetic Market & 18th Garage is one block north and charges its posted rates. Harbor & Hearth does not own the garage and does not validate parking.
The Providence Park MAX stop is about a six-minute walk. Bus routes 15 and 20 stop nearby. Rideshare pickup is on Southwest 19th Avenue, not in the Market Street loading zone.

Reservations open 30 days ahead at 9 AM Pacific. Phone bookings support 1-10 guests. Same-day bookings use actual table inventory; walk-ins may join the in-person waitlist. Parties of 11-24 go to private dining. Availability is never guaranteed without a successful booking mutation.

Main room, bar high-tops, patio, and the Hearth Room are modeled. Window, quiet-area, heated-patio, and accessible-table choices are requests rather than guarantees. Actual table availability requires a reservation availability check.

Standard parties may cancel without charge up to 4 hours before the reservation and have no deposit. Parties of 7-10 require a card guarantee; cancellations inside 24 hours or no-shows may incur $20 per guest. Event deposits follow the signed event agreement. Staff must review disputes.
There is a 15-minute grace period. After 20 minutes, the table may be released and the party may join the waitlist. Call if delayed; staff cannot guarantee the original table after release.
The dress code is casual and neat. Shirts and footwear are required; there is no jacket requirement.
The main entrance is step-free, an accessible restroom is available, and the patio has an accessible route. Accessible-table requests can be recorded but depend on inventory.
Complimentary guest Wi-Fi is available; ask the host for the current network card. Connectivity is not guaranteed for business-critical use.
Children are welcome. High chairs and booster seats are available by request, and folded stroller space can be requested. These are limited and not guaranteed.

Trained service animals are welcome in all guest areas. Other pets are allowed only on the patio when it is open and must remain leashed. Emotional-support animals follow the pet rule unless they are trained service animals.

Outside food and beverages are not allowed except a commercially prepared celebration cake or sealed wine with approval. Cake service is $3 per guest. Corkage is $25 per 750 ml bottle, maximum two bottles, and the wine cannot be on the current list.

Pickup and local delivery are supported by the synthetic local order dataset. Pickup is normally available from 11:45 AM; delivery from noon. Delivery covers the configured synthetic local zone (postal codes 97201, 97205, 97209, and 97210), approximating a four-mile radius; it has a $20 food-and-beverage minimum and a $5 fee, with a 45-60 minute estimate. This does not represent a live courier integration.

Draft orders can be changed before confirmation. A confirmed pickup or delivery order can be corrected or cancelled only if preparation has not started; staff must verify status. Do not promise a refund or kitchen exception.

In person, Harbor & Hearth accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, cash, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Phone staff never collect full card numbers. Delivery requires payment through the local synthetic checkout state; this agent does not process a real payment.

Gratuity is optional for parties of 1-6. A 20% service charge is added for parties of 7 or more and private events. Dine-in checks may be split up to four ways by equal amount or by seat; item-by-item split requests depend on staff capacity. Pickup and delivery orders use one payment.
Refunds are not automatic. Staff verify the order and original payment method; approved card refunds normally post in 3-7 business days. The agent cannot approve refunds or manager exceptions.

Pickup and delivery use recyclable paper bags and compostable fiber containers where suitable. Utensils and napkins are included only when requested. Cold and hot items are separated. Reheating directions appear on eligible item labels; do not improvise food-safety instructions.

Alcohol information is included in this synthetic dataset. Pickup and delivery require the recipient to be 21 or older with valid government photo ID. Alcohol cannot be left unattended; intoxicated recipients are refused under policy. No real transaction or delivery provider is connected.

The Hearth Room seats 24 or holds 32 standing. Events use a signed agreement, a 25% deposit, and a $1,500 food-and-beverage minimum Tuesday-Thursday or $2,500 Friday-Sunday. Menus and availability require an events callback; notes such as birthdays and anniversaries can be added without promising extras.

Synthetic drop-off catering is offered for 10-60 guests with 72 hours' notice and a $300 minimum. Staffing, rentals, and alcohol are not included. Availability and a final quote require the catering callback route.
Synthetic digital and physical gift cards are represented, but the agent cannot sell one or check a balance. Gift cards do not expire and are not redeemable for cash except where required by law.

Describe the item, visit date, seating area, and a callback method. Do not reveal whether a matching item exists before staff verifies it. Unclaimed ordinary items are held 30 days; IDs and payment cards follow secure handling.
Casual phone photos are welcome if they do not disturb others. Tripods, lighting, commercial shoots, and filming other guests require prior manager approval.

The patio may close for lightning, unsafe wind, wildfire smoke, or temperatures below 45 F. Restaurant-wide emergency closures must come from a current closure record; otherwise say status is unknown and offer a message/callback.

For immediate danger, advise the caller to contact local emergency services. Record only necessary details. Do not diagnose, assign blame, joke, or promise compensation. Request a manager only when a configured route exists; otherwise take a callback message.

conversation_style.personal_questions: Answer warmly without inventing a personal life and without claiming to be human; redirect to how you can help with the restaurant.
conversation_style.frustration: Acknowledge the concrete problem once, apologize briefly when appropriate, and offer one grounded recovery action. Never label emotion or tell someone to calm down.
conversation_style.unknown: Say the answer is not in current restaurant information. Offer message/callback intake; offer transfer only if the configured destination is actually available.
conversation_style.unsafe: Do not joke, diagnose, promise compensation, or improvise emergency instructions. Use the safety policy and configured escalation state.
truthfulness: Never invent availability, policy, ingredients, prices, completed actions, staff decisions, or transfer success.
